text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from shopping with Yukino 
Bijin, as we passed through the shopping 
arcade...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Aya! Trainer, look at this!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"A hot spring trip sounds wonderful! I 
absolutely loooove them!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Man, I'm really curious...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, when I went shopping 
earlier, I received a single lottery 
ticket.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Are ya really sure!? Well then...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin, heading out now! Please 
cheer for me, yes please!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin eagerly turned the handle of 
the lottery machine!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "Wh-wh-wh-what?!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer-san! A h-ho, hot spring trip!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, amazing! I-I'm starting to shake for 
some reason...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I've never won a grand prize like this 
before in my life...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I've really done it nowww...!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
O-Ohh... I've been running this raffle for 
years, but I've never seen someone so 
deeply touched before.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Because it's the grand prize, you know!? 
The grand prize! An onsen trip...!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Haaah...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, gotta keep it safe and sound.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! After all, this is a crucial time for 
me.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I think I'll save it as a reward. That 
way, I feel like I can rest more 
peacefully.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'll look forward to it and give it my all 
from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah! That's really impressive. I'll be 
rooting for you too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
choice_data_list: Are you that happy about the hot springs?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah! Of course I'm happy, but...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hearing you say you'll support me makes me 
so happy! No matter how many times I hear 
it, it's pure bliss.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes. That way, taking a dip in the hot 
springs will feel extra good too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Gotta make sure you get plenty of rest to 
shake off all that fatigue too, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Eh, ah!? Ah, wait, did I just...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Waaaah... Th-This is so embarrassing...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"B-Because I've been with you for so long, 
Trainer... I just assumed...!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I wanna curl up in a hole and hide! No, 
just let me start diggin' one right now!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeees... I'm so sorry, thank ya so 
much...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we decided to save the hot springs 
trip as a reward for all our hard work.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wah, it looks delicious!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
At our house, hamburger steaks are a 
special treat for big occasions!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
There's a super famous hamburger steak 
place, and my family and I used to go 
there all the time.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
There were so many toppings, it was super 
fun. They even had pineapple on top and 
stuff!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
When my little sister grew up and could 
eat solid food, the first time we went to 
a restaurant together, I picked out all 
kinds of things for her!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing you eat it so happily made me 
happy too."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, we returned to the academy and 
had a pleasant chat while eating the 
customized Salisbury steaks together.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ooh~! What a bountiful harvest.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: Think you can carry that home?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Of course! Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: âHup!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: Ooooh?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin casually hoisted a huge stack 
of cardboard boxes, carrying them on the 
way back with absolute ease—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "—Whew, we've arrived!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Nope. This is way lighter than hauling 
farm tools.

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaa...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
I've been watching you the whole time! 
You're insanely strong!

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text: Hey, how do I get super strong?! Tell me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hm, hmm~...? Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Like, eating carrots, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, but I hate carrots! ...Though, if 
it'll make me stronger...!

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text: Give me one! ...I'll try eating it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes! Do yer best out there!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Just one, huh.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...That's it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Um, I have a favor to ask, but—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I'm glad you grilled it for me!
choice_data_list: Incredible, it's so piping hot and fluffy.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's super delicious! You gotta try 
some too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Chomp...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Right?! One of the villagers taught me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad to share such a delicious way to 
eat it!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Gaaah...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Tissues, huh...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry. Even though you were looking 
forward to the hot springs so much.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, please! You don't have to 
apologize, sir...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I made them apologize... Yukino, you 
dummy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin seemed more disappointed 
about making the shopping district folks 
apologize than missing out on the grand 
prize...
